# Alexandr Chumak

> EU citizen, no sponsorship required. Senior Frontend Engineer with 6+ years building for production in React, TypeScript and Next.js. Currently Lead Frontend Developer at Multisoft (Romania, remote). Open to senior frontend and AI product roles across the EU.

Builds the client app for the Multisoft restaurant CRM: order and menu modules, reporting tables, filtering, long forms. Built two AI products single-handedly. Prosvetum is an iOS book-summary app on Expo and React Native with a Supabase backend, shipped to TestFlight as v1.0.0: a RAG mentor built on Voyage embeddings in pgvector behind an HNSW index, answers streamed from Claude over SSE, Postgres row-level security across 20 migrations, and server-enforced AI quotas. Rivella is an AI sales assistant on Next.js that answers in Telegram and books appointments through YClients, with RAG over a per-tenant knowledge base and an admin panel; built end to end, not launched to production. Five years before that at EVCARGO on an e-mobility logistics platform, owning the design system, component library and client-side architecture, and running frontend code review. Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, React Native / Expo, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Zod. Based in Chișinău, UTC+2.
